about: Wraps a control in a label, the text a person needs in advance, a count and what is wrong. The root provides the state, identifiers and limit to every part.

count.about: `Field.Counter` shows the length of the value against the root's `maxLength` and updates as a person types. It counts UTF-16 code units, the unit `maxLength` limits. The control lists the counter in `aria-describedby`. `Field.Textarea` takes every prop of `Textarea`, so this field grows to six rows.
count.title: Count

courier: The courier reads these at the door.
invoiced: Printed on every invoice we send you.
monthly: We send one letter a month.
note: Leave the parcel at the side door. The front bell is broken.

optional.about: A label that holds a badge in place of the required mark. The label lays its children out in a row.
optional.title: Optional

orientation.about: The label above the control, beside it, and floating inside it. Beside the control, the label is centred against it. A floating label rests inside an empty control and rises once the control has focus or a value. It reads emptiness from `:placeholder-shown`, so the control needs a placeholder, and a single space works.
orientation.title: Orientations

paired.about: Two fields in a grid. A field fills the column it is given and states no width of its own.
paired.title: Two on a line

reported.error: Enter the number with its country code.
reported.info: We send the receipt here as well as the invoice.
reported.warning: That address bounced the last time we wrote to it.

size.about: Every size. The size reaches the control, the label reads the label role at the size, and the texts under the control read the body role one size smaller.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: Rest, required, disabled, read-only and invalid. The required mark renders only on a required field, and the error text replaces the helper text while the field is invalid.
states.title: States

status.about: One field per status. A status sets the control's edge and the ink of the error text, which leads with a mark so the four read apart without color. Only the error marks the control invalid and sets `role="alert"`.
status.title: Statuses

title: Field
unknown: That address is not one we recognise.
